name: nexalayer
description: Managed proxy sessions, health, rotation, usage, and spend controls for AI agents.
long_description: Connect AI agents and browser automation to NexaLayer managed network Sessions. Discover current products and prices, create and rotate Sessions, inspect health and usage, and enforce owner-controlled spend limits.

tools.name: nexalayer_list_products
tools.description: List current NexaLayer products and exact prices before purchasing.

tools.name: nexalayer_create_session
tools.description: Create an owner-approved paid network Session with an idempotency key.

tools.name: nexalayer_rotate_session
tools.description: Rotate a dynamic Session when health or telemetry recommends it.

tools.name: nexalayer_session_health
tools.description: Read Session health score and rotation recommendation.

tools.name: nexalayer_session_usage
tools.description: Read traffic and request usage for a Session.

tools.name: nexalayer_get_budget
tools.description: Read current spend limits, spend, pause state, and daily reset.

tools.name: nexalayer_set_budget
tools.description: Set owner-controlled key and daily spend limits with an idempotency key.

api_key.title: NexaLayer API Key
api_key.description: Request an API key and one-time trial at https://nexalayer.net/agents?source=smithery

base_url.title: API Base URL
base_url.description: Override only for a private or test NexaLayer deployment.
